Kill [[Fronis Irontoe]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Fronis Irontoe in [[Fronis Irontoe's Lair|his lair]].
* *BONUS* Kill Fronis Irontoe in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
The easiest way to receive credit for this quest is to receive [[Kilroy Stonekin]]'s buff, [["Kilroy Stonekin"]], and run past all of the enemies directly to Fronis Irontoe. You can bypass the final blockade by staying to the right side. 

Alternatively, see the walkthrough at [[Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!#Walkthrough|Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!]].
